changelog: Retire the ratchet re-risk override and arm cash momentum for an empty defensive sleeve. The allocator was computing posture from a fabricated defensive momentum of 0, which meant 'there are no bonds' rather than 'bonds returned zero'; it now uses the TBILL_13W trailing return over the same 18-month window, compared against UNDISCOUNTED risk momentum (the vol suppressor shrinks equity momentum multiplicatively, and zero was safe only as the fixed point of that shrink). Also relocates min_position_pct from book level to the equity sleeve so a position floor can no longer delete the entire bond book. CAGR 21.12% -> 20.93%; maxDD and worst-12mo bit-identical. D6: 3 of 4 instruments improve; cohorts-still-behind 1.10% -> 1.47% accepted, see the acceptance reason.
